Picnic table on the left side centered horizontally. Large rock formation in the background and river at the base of rock formation. Trees and large rocks in center with open spaces for tent set up and parking.

Post marker with the site number on it located in the bottom right side of picture. Open area for parking leads up to some boulders, picnic table and fire ring in the middle. Trees and open sandy area in the background meant for tent set up.

One tree in the center of photo and multiple photos and bushes along the edges of campsite. Parking area leading from bottom center up to the center of photo. Picnic table, fire ring, and trees and bushes on the left hand side. More trees and bushes on the right hand side. River can be seen in the background and a large rock formation can be seen behind that.

Parking area in foreground and center of photo. Picnic table and fire ring on the edge of parking area in center of the photo. Bushes and trees on either side of picnic table and fire ring and in the background.

Parking area leading from the bottom right corner to just above the center of the photo. Picnic table and fire ring at the top of the parking area with bushes and trees bordering the campsite. River in the background and rock formations on the other side of the river.
Large open area for parking in the center and majority of photo. Picnic table and fire ring in the center background with trees and bushes around the perimeter of the campsite.

Fire ring in the bottom center of photo. Picnic table on the right side. Parking area in the center of photo. Trees and  bushes on the perimeter of the campsite. River in the background and large rock formation behind the river.

Picnic table and fire ring in the right center of photo. Another picnic table on the other side of pull through parking area for campground close to the center. Open area for tent set up in the front and center of photo. River shown in flowing from right to left in center of photo behind campsite. Tree in front of river and large rock formation across the river.
